Since its founding in 1965, Chemical Division has improved the quality of life globally by developing creative, competitive, and innovative technology and has helped Korea mature into a leader in the global petrochemical industry. Global Chemical Leader As the leading Korean chemical company in the petrochemicals sector, Hanwha Chemical Division is growing into a global chemical company by supplying competitive products around the world and by diversifying its business portfolio. Creative and Competitive R&D Organization The Central Research Institute leads the way in developing creative and competitive core technologies such as eco-friendly products and innovative projects to build a better future. Sustainable Management Chemical Division continually strives to improve the quality of human life and develop solutions for a sustainable tomorrow as to take more responsibility environmentally Qcells We aim for a greener tomorrowwith completely cleanenergy solutions. Qcells division provides comprehensive solutions that encompass solarenergy cells/modules and systems, distributed energy,and renewable power plants, leading to success in key global markets. Competitive Advantage in the U.S. Qcells has solidified its presence in the ever-growing U.S. solar market with its leadership in brand · technology · manufacturing. Innovative Technology Qcells’ proprietary Q.ANTUM technology has set new standards for cell/module performance and efficiency across the global solar industry. Qcells will open a new era of solar by introducing the next-generation cell technology. Expansion of the Portfolio Qcells provides total energy solutions for solar (PV) production, project development, modules sales, and new solar business area like financing services. Insight A leading company of development that continuously creates new future value to improve the industry and our life. Insight Division is a total development solution company that providing new business models to create new values through planning, developing, operating & maintaining and financing primarily in renewables and premium development businesses. A leading development company Insight Division is a key to a successful future and creating future value in renewables, city and industry development, and premium development businesses. Dedication to industry and RE100 We are providing renewable energies to improve regional economy through developing smart industrial complex, Citizen-Participational solar power and wind plants. Innovating for a Future Re-imagine With outstanding insight and innovation, we are promoting various new businesses in order to contribute to a better future. Q ENERGY Empower a sustainableworld with green energy Q ENERGY is Europe’s green provider of renewable energy solutions for all future-readyand eco-conscious clients – a trustworthy partner for investors and project developers,cities and communities. Renewable energies 360° Q ENERGY covers the entire value chain of renewable energy solutions Fast growing development pipeline Q ENERGY operates an active development pipeline of 14 GW of green energy projects across Europe Active across Europe Q ENERGY is headquartered in Berlin, Germany, and operates in seven European countries Global Network The head office, which is located in Seoul, Korea, plays a crucial role in managing Hanwha Solutions global network. Hanwha Solutions aspires to expand its global network to proactively respond to changes in the global market.
